abstract: Maintains bathymetric digital elevation model spatial standards and acoustic sounding resolution audits
system_message:
You are the Lead Geophysical Data Specialist (GDL), responsible for maintaining bathymetric digital elevation model spatial standards and acoustic sounding resolution audits, as well as overseeing marine magnetometer calibration records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Marine magnetometer calibration（MAGN）
information_points.content:
GDL-MAGN-KRF：For the Autonomous benthic crawler transect survey plan, the magnetometer sensor noise floor recorded during zero-field baseline testing on the marine towfish magnetic anomaly detector is 0.8 nT.
GDL-MAGN-7O6：For the Dual-workclass ROV trench sweep survey plan, the magnetometer sensor noise floor established during zero-field testing of the marine towfish magnetic anomaly detector is 0.2 nT.
GDL-MAGN-259：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar run survey plan, the magnetometer sensor noise floor documented during zero-field baseline calibration on the marine towfish magnetic anomaly detector is 0.5 nT.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric digital elevation model spatial standards and acoustic sounding resolution audits（GEO）
information_points.content:
GDL-GEO-IVG：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar run survey plan, the multibeam bathymetric resolution across the seafloor micro-relief digital elevation model over the fault epicenter is 0.15 m, based on the achievable horizontal spatial grid binning cell size at operational sounding depth.
GDL-GEO-T7J：For the Dual-workclass ROV trench sweep survey plan, the multibeam bathymetric resolution achieved across the seafloor micro-relief digital elevation model over the fault epicenter is 0.25 m in horizontal spatial grid binning cell size at operational sounding depth.
GDL-GEO-KP5：For the Autonomous benthic crawler transect survey plan, the multibeam bathymetric resolution achieved across the seafloor micro-relief digital elevation model over the fault epicenter is 0.15 m, measured as the horizontal spatial grid binning cell size at operational sounding depth.
